updateMessage: CineVault v3.2.1 (5.3 MB) introduces our sculpted Midnight Sapphire Ribbon logo across the app and splash screen, plus Play Protect hardening. Upgrading from v3.1.0 or older: uninstall the older app once first before installing.
changelog: New Sculpted Sapphire Ribbon app identity & adaptive launcher icons
Compact 5.3 MB signed release build with Play Protect hardening
IMPORTANT: If installing over v3.1.0 shows a package conflict, uninstall the older build once first
Family Mode Setting: Hides all 18+/19+ mature content when ON and unlocks all content when OFF
Fresh 2024+ Live Hero Banners, Universal Search & smooth Landscape playback
